tooltip.frostedheart.stratadrill.steam_d: Right-click a Steam Charger to dock. Right-click with an empty main hand to retrieve.
tetra.module.stratadrill/head.name: Drill Head
tetra.module.stratadrill/drive.name: Drive
tetra.variant.stratadrill/spiral.descrip: Mines one block at a time when powered.
tetra/schematic/stratadrill/spiral.name: Fit Spiral Drill Head
tetra/schematic/stratadrill/spiral.descr: Use 2 iron ingots and a stone-tier hammer. Fits an iron spiral head for single-block mining. The old head's material does not transfer.
tetra.variant.stratadrill/wheel.descript: When powered, cuts a 3×3 area on the target face. Sneak to mine one block.
tetra/schematic/stratadrill/wheel.name: Fit Tunnelling Wheel
tetra/schematic/stratadrill/wheel.descri: Use 3 steel plates for the wheel body and an iron-tier hammer. The new head has standard iron material. Mines 3×3 when powered; sneak to mine one block.
tetra/schematic/stratadrill/cutting_edge: Normally uses 1 iron ingot or 2 steel ingots. No hammer. Keeps the head shape, drive, fuel, and wear percentage.
tetra.improvement.stratadrill/cutting_ed: The material fitted to this drill head.
Mines faster and lasts longer than iron, with the same mining tier.
tetra.variant.stratadrill/steam.descript: Uses stored steam charge. Dock at a Steam Charger to refill.
tetra/schematic/stratadrill/steam.name: Fit Steam Drive
tetra/schematic/stratadrill/steam.descri: Use 3 iron plates and a stone-tier hammer. Recharge at a steam charger. Switching drives keeps the drill head and stored fuel.
tetra.variant.stratadrill/diesel.descrip: Mines faster on biodiesel. Refill from a biodiesel tank or a Create Spout.
tetra/schematic/stratadrill/diesel.name: Fit Diesel Drive
tetra/schematic/stratadrill/diesel.descr: Use 4 steel plates and an iron-tier hammer. Uses biodiesel to mine faster. Switching drives keeps the drill head and stored fuel.
